relations.subject: Nathaniel Brassey Halhed
relations.evidence: He went to Harrow School from the age of seven to seventeen.

relations.subject: Nathaniel Brassey Halhed
relations.evidence: Halhed entered Christ Church, Oxford on 13 July 1768, at the age of 17. He remained there for three years but did not take a degree.

relations.subject: Nathaniel Brassey Halhed
relations.evidence: While at Christ Church, Oxford he undertook oriental studies under the influence of William Jones, who induced him to study Arabic.
